items.v: Built in the Workshop, Proven on the Mill Floor

Founded in Bardhaman, West Bengal, Shakti Engineering Works has spent over 20 years designing and fabricating the pre-milling machinery that modern rice mills across India, Bangladesh, Myanmar and Sri Lanka run on every day.
From a Small Fabrication Unit to a Pan-India Manufacturer

What began as a small fabrication workshop serving local rice mills has grown into a full pre-milling machinery manufacturer — every elevator, dryer, parboiling plant and silo engineered, fabricated and quality-checked in-house.
Today Shakti Engineering Works equips more than 500 mills, with installations pan-India and exports to Bangladesh, Myanmar and Sri Lanka, backed by ISO 9001:2015 certified quality systems.
From a Small Fabrication Unit to a Pan-India Manufacturer

items.v: From Raw Paddy to Perfectly Milled Rice
One connected line, engineered end to end — every machine designed to hand off cleanly to the next.
Removes stalks, dust and stones before paddy enters the mill, protecting every downstream machine from debris and wear.
Multi-pass vertical dryers reduce moisture evenly across the grain, sized to your daily throughput from 18 to 56 tons, for consistent milling quality batch after batch.
Steam-pressure parboiling plants lock in nutrition and grain strength, with integrated water tanks sized up to 50 KL for continuous operation.
Heavy-duty bucket elevators move grain cleanly between every stage of the line, engineered for dryers, parboiling sections, silos and standalone use.
Custom-capacity paddy and rice silos, plus dust collection and cyclone systems, keep grain protected and your mill floor clean until it's ready to move on.
A complete, tension-free pre-milling section — screw and tube conveyors, blowers, pulleys and pipeline fittings all engineered to work as one line, ready for your mill.

sections.label: Hero: Everything Your Pre-Milling Line Needs

items.v: 304-grade stainless steel construction, sized from 150mm to 600mm, with fully customised solutions on request — every machine designed, fabricated and quality-checked in-house.
Engineered for dryers, parboiling lines and silos, plus standalone individual elevators.
Single and double vertical dryers, even moisture reduction sized to your throughput.
Pressure parboiling systems, with water-tank integration, built for consistent grain strength and colour.
Custom-capacity paddy and rice storage silos built to your site footprint.
Twin-cyclone separators and dust collection units for a cleaner mill floor.
Low-power-consumption blowers, pulleys and vibrating screens engineered to last.
FRP tube and screw conveyors for flour mills and rice mill transfer lines.
Heavy-duty trough belt conveyors for high-volume grain transfer.
Steel water tanks sized for parboiling plants, up to 50 KL capacity.
Vibrating stroke chalna units that separate paddy from brown rice with precision.
Finned-tube heat exchangers for efficient, even drying performance.
Polished stainless-steel Y and T-joint pipeline fittings for flour mill ducting.
Geared motor drive assemblies built for continuous-duty screw and tube conveyors.
Send us your capacity, footprint and grain type — we'll size the right machine for your mill.
